shortlist.label: Facial nerve schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: Gradual-onset unilateral facial weakness with a mass in the ear canal and imaging findings of a lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen

shortlist.label: Chondrosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of a mass in the ear canal and expansion of the stylomastoid foramen, with pathology showing cartilage and pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei

shortlist.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the ear canal and facial weakness, with pathology showing pleomorphic nuclei and a myxochondroid matrix

shortlist.label: Facial nerve hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the ear canal and facial weakness, with imaging findings of a lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen

shortlist.label: Geniculate ganglion hemangioma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the ear canal and facial weakness, with imaging findings of a lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen and expansion of the fallopian canal

raw.rationale: The patient's 2-year history of gradual-onset right facial weakness, nonpulsatile mass in the inferior ear canal, and imaging findings of an irregular lesion in the right mastoid near the stylomastoid foramen are consistent with a facial nerve schwannoma. The microscopic examination showing pleomorphic hyperchromatic nuclei, staining positive for S100, and low cellularity also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Chondrosarcoma
rejected.why: The microscopic examination did not show typical cartilaginous matrix and high cellularity expected in chondrosarcoma

rejected.label: Pleomorphic adenoma
rejected.why: The location and imaging findings are not typical for pleomorphic adenoma, which is more commonly found in the salivary glands

rejected.label: Facial nerve hemangioma
rejected.why: The imaging findings and microscopic examination did not show the characteristic vascular features of a hemangioma

rejected.label: Geniculate ganglion hemangioma
rejected.why: The location of the lesion is not consistent with the geniculate ganglion, and the imaging findings did not show the characteristic features of a hemangioma

gold: Low-grade chondrosarcoma of the mastoid with facial nerve involvement
